fields.exportVersion: Semantic version of the public export package.
fields.releaseDate: UTC date on which this formal public release was published.
fields.snapshotDate: UTC editorial snapshot date represented by the file.
fields.generatedAt: Stable UTC release timestamp for this dated snapshot; not an evidence date.
fields.licence: Reuse terms for the database and original editorial annotations. Third-party source materials are excluded.
fields.metrics: Stable definitions of the nine reliability disclosure questions.
fields.records: Public source-linked Reliability Records. Private candidate and sparse internal evidence-model objects are excluded.
fields.records[].claims: Atomic public statements with stable IDs, evidence levels and source links.
fields.records[].disclosures: Known, unknown or reasoned not-applicable state for each reliability question.
fields.records[].analysisScope: System, configuration and mission boundary used to interpret record claims.
fields.records[].sources: Public source metadata and retrieval-integrity fields.
fields.records[].sources[].sourceMetadataFinger: SHA-256 of canonical metadata exported for this source; not a fingerprint of third-party page content.
fields.records[].sources[].relevantLocation: Exact page, section, table or passage locator when retained; null means none is currently published.
fields.records[].sources[].archiveReference: Stable HumanoidUptime artifact ID for a retained verification copy, or an external archive reference where stated; null means no preserved artifact is currently registered.
fields.records[].sources[].archiveAccess: Access boundary for the retained artifact. Internal evidence copies are not included in the public export.
fields.records[].sources[].capturedAt: UTC timestamp of the preserved HTTP response body, when available.
fields.records[].sources[].capturedMediaType: HTTP media type recorded when the preserved response body was captured.
fields.records[].sources[].capturedByteLength: Exact byte length of the retained decoded response body.
fields.records[].sources[].contentFingerprint: Fingerprint of retained third-party source content when lawful and technically reliable; null does not imply the source was not reviewed.
fields.sourcePreservation: Public scope and rights boundary of the preservation pilot. Artifact bodies, response headers and internal paths are excluded.
fields.recordHistory: Effective public-knowledge states with evidence date separate from reconstruction date.
fields.deployments: Public deployment, pilot, plan and benchmark signals; a listing is not a full Reliability Record.
fields.coverage: Declared 30-program research universe, search boundary and public outcome at the cutoff.
fields.externalReviews: Attributed scoped spot checks. An empty array means none has been published.

excluded: private candidate observations and gate notes
raw evidence submissions and contact data
sparse Operational Evidence and Measurement Provenance working objects pending a separate public presentation decision
